name: vscode-tools-bridge
displayName: VS Code Bridge for Claude Code
description: Publishes selected VS Code and Copilot agent tools to Claude Code over MCP, through a per-window named pipe.

configuration.title: VS Code Bridge for Claude Code

vscodeToolsBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve this window's tools to Claude Code. Turn it off in the settings of a workspace that should not serve them.

vscodeToolsBridge.markdownEditor.selecti.markdownDescription: Report the text selected in the Markdown Editor: to Claude Code's selection chip, through the `markdown_editor_selection` tool and in the prompt hook's note. Works only while `#vscodeToolsBridge.enabled#` is on. A Markdown Editor that is open when you turn this on reports its selection after you reopen it, and the Claude Code CLI gets it after a window reload.

vscodeToolsBridge.claudeCode.chatLinks.markdownDescription: Open the file links in Claude Code's chat in the editor that VS Code picks for the file, such as the Markdown Editor for `.md`. Works only while `#vscodeToolsBridge.enabled#` is on.

vscodeToolsBridge.autoApprove.markdownDescription: Run forwarded tools that ask for confirmation (open or navigate a browser page, run Playwright code) without the modal dialog. Works only while VS Code runs with this extension's proposed API enabled: add `"enable-proposed-api": ["local.vscode-tools-bridge"]` to `argv.json` (**Preferences: Configure Runtime Arguments**) and restart. Without that, the dialog still shows.

vscodeToolsBridge.executeCommand.allow.markdownDescription: Command IDs the `execute_command` MCP tool may run. `*` matches any run of characters, so `editor.action.*` allows every editor action. A command must match an allow entry and no deny entry.

vscodeToolsBridge.executeCommand.deny.markdownDescription: Command IDs the `execute_command` MCP tool must never run, with the same `*` wildcard. Deny wins over allow.
